aggregation: One row per independent geometry and method; timing is median of three fresh repetitions. All ratios are computed within geometry before split medians. No learned models or training-seed aggregation.

posthoc_cost.aggregation: Subtract search from total within each recorded repeat, then take median repeats within geometry. Divide that remainder by the same geometry's median fine-direct time, then aggregate across geometries. Search fraction is likewise formed per repeat before geometry medians.
posthoc_cost.interpretation: Hypothetical bookkeeping only: remove the entire measured candidate-search stage including conditional-state updates while retaining all other measured stages. No replacement learned inference or altered architecture/setup costs are charged. This is not an achievable acceleration, a numerical-method or hardware-independent lower bound, or evidence of a speedup.

mechanism_comparison_scope: Coupled and uncoupled methods can follow different candidate paths; their comparison is descriptive and is not a uniquely isolated causal effect.

decision.note: The limited greedy action family passes the prespecified accuracy headroom gate. This is not deployability, efficiency, AI necessity or novelty evidence.

audit.limitation: No PDE or Schur recomputation: stored scalar energy/residual values are range-checked, final QoI/Schur changes are cross-checked, recorded trajectories and combinatorial feasibility are reconstructed. Non-winning candidate values and full solution fields were not stored, so independent numerical argmax and energy re-evaluation are not claimed.
